This behavior enables automated fetching and installation of platform-specific binaries from a hardcoded external URL, facilitating remote code provisioning during package installation.
slice_results.explanation: [LLM Judgment: Benign] The analyzed code downloads prebuilt binaries from a hardcoded, legitimate GitHub repository URL (https://github.com/mystk/iohook/releases) during installation, which is a common and accepted practice for native modules to ease installation across platforms. It uses standard libraries (nugget, tar-fs, zlib) to download and extract these binaries. There is no evidence of obfuscation, execution of arbitrary scripts via npm lifecycle hooks, or attempts to execute remote code beyond fetching prebuilt binaries. Unlike the known malicious patterns, this code does not execute arbitrary scripts during install, does not use suspicious npm hooks, and does not download or execute code from untrusted or unknown domains. The behavior aligns with legitimate package installation practices rather than malware delivery or persistence mechanisms.
